findings.text: follow-on: the docstring at budget.py:261-263 states only the base rate tier carries cache rates in the project catalog, but imas_codex/settings.py:107-108 now copies cache-read/cache-write onto override tiers and pyproject.toml declares them for both GPT-6 entries, so a future consumer reading override cache rates through budget.blended_input_rate's base-tier-only blend (lines 288-289) would misprice; no request reaches the 272000-token threshold today, so the inconsistency is latent.

follow-on: request['model'] is asserted equal to the same model parameter handed to _build_kwargs (line 81), the f(x)==x shape, so it holds whatever the code does and cannot independently prove GPT-6 routing; the sibling line 95 compares max_tokens against llm.MODEL_TOKEN_LIMITS['default'], a constant the production code itself reads, so it moves with the code rather than pinning it.

item_verdicts.diff: commit a6f26bbb322d0269c4f8cb7fe77f408aa9d96d74 changes pyproject.toml pricing, imas_codex/settings.py, imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py and adds tests/core/test_gpt6_model_support.py; 5ea688a55001f8e8578c5bfc6f6ad13abb372d1c and 1ceca6a195c0730518bc75af621fd78c7c23ae00 touch only docs/evidence/fragments/llm-seats/llm-gpt6-support.html and 7ff8c09ced00af348080f507f5ca47a2ccea9bf9 repairs the test file.
item_verdicts.done_when: docs/evidence/fragments/llm-seats/llm-gpt6-support.html records the priced entries with source, the family-handling change, the two probe costs (probe.log), the red control (repair-negative-control.log, refusal-check.log) and the base-to-head gate counts, satisfying every item the source brief's done-when names.
item_verdicts.goal: the source brief requires the call layer to price and call gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6-luna without changing any seat; pyproject.toml declares both rates with source and verified-at, imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:2155 extends the temperature rule, and probe.log records one non-null-cost call per model with no seat model changed.
item_verdicts.manifest: the reviewed manifest records the two live costs, the repaired gate totals (baseline 213 / head 220 passed, zero added failures), and the negative-control log; the earlier KeyError control was replaced, so its blocking finding no longer stands.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest declares six paths and git diff 078b20ea335c73a9e3649cf8f728eea908666b06..1ceca6a195c0730518bc75af621fd78c7c23ae00 changes five of them, all inside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: tests/core/test_gpt6_model_support.py:42 fails with ProviderPricingUnbounded when the pyproject entries are removed (repair-negative-control.log, EXIT=1), lines 60-70 pin the fail-closed refusal, and line 94 fails if the temperature clamp is reverted to a GPT-5-only regex; lines 91 and 95 are the weaker echo and constant-tied assertions.
justifications.evidence: final-gate.log records 220 passed at committed head 1ceca6a195c0730518bc75af621fd78c7c23ae00 against a 213-passed baseline-gate.log, zero added failures, and probe.log records both live costs; the red control now reaches the call-layer refusal rather than stopping at a KeyError.
justifications.fit: imas_codex/settings.py:107-108 extends the existing override parser and imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:2155 extends the existing temperature rule in the surrounding style, with conventional commit subjects.
justifications.goal_fidelity: pyproject.toml supplies both models' verified rates and imas_codex/settings.py:1949-1980 adds them to the benchmark slates, no seat model changed, and probe.log records both production calls at non-null cost.
justifications.reuse: capability searches for pricing resolution, request construction and benchmark defaults found the existing owners at imas_codex/settings.py:87, imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:2008 and imas_codex/settings.py:1949, which the change extends rather than duplicates.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff 078b20ea335c73a9e3649cf8f728eea908666b06..1ceca6a195c0730518bc75af621fd78c7c23ae00 lies inside the manifest's declared write paths, though imas_codex/settings.py:107-108 adds override cache rates beyond the shape of the named gpt-5.6-luna entry.
